park: Biidaasige Park (Ookwemin Minising / Lower Don Lands / Port Lands)
purpose: Bounded primary-source search for CURRENT (2025/2026) as-built ground relief of the new park. Records what actual elevation data exists, its date/datum/units, and the exact negative checks. Does NOT invent a hill and does NOT treat pre-park DEM as current grade.
headline: No published 2025/2026 LiDAR, DSM, DEM, contour or as-built grading plan covers the new park. The only City/Provincial bare-earth and surface models over the park are GTA 2023 (and GTA 2015) LiDAR, acquired BEFORE the park opened (2025 east / 2026 west). The ~9 m western promontory is a primary DESIGN fact (MVVA) plus a primary CONSTRUCTION description (Waterfront Toronto, March 2025), not a surveyed surface. No source geometry is published, so no walkable mesh can be derived from actual data yet.

negativeChecks.check: City of Toronto Open Data: 2025/2026 LiDAR, DSM, DEM, contour or spot-elevation dataset
negativeChecks.detail: CKAN package_search for 'elevation', 'digital surface model', 'contour', 'topographic', 'digital elevation', 'ground elevation', 'LiDAR 2025', 'LiDAR 2026', 'bare earth', 'spot elevation', 'survey monument' returned only the 2023-derived TIN, 3D Massing (buildings), and topographic vector layers (no elevation raster). No 2025/2026 elevation product exists.

negativeChecks.check: City of Toronto basemap services: current-year LiDAR hillshade
negativeChecks.detail: gis.toronto.ca basemap folder lists only cot_LiDAR_2015_Hillshade_BareEarth and cot_LiDAR_2015_Hillshade_FullFeature. No 2025/2026 hillshade.

negativeChecks.check: City 3D Massing 2025 as a ground-elevation source
negativeChecks.detail: 3D Massing is building footprint/massing geometry only (81 MB shapefile, refreshed 2026-04). It carries no bare-earth or ground elevation attribute. Not a terrain source.

negativeChecks.check: Provincial LiDAR newer than 2023 covering the park
negativeChecks.detail: Ontario DTM/DSM package index returns only GTA 2023 and GTA 2015 tiles at the park point. The '2024 LiDAR - Hydro Enforced DTM' item is Washington, D.C. (dcgis), not Toronto. Ontario DEM_ImageryDerived returns NoData at the park.

negativeChecks.check: Waterfront Toronto published grading / landscape tender / as-built / contour plan
negativeChecks.detail: Sitemap and document-library search for 'grading', 'tender', 'as-built', 'elevation', 'contour', 'survey', 'landscape', 'technical' returned only precinct plans, design-review agendas/minutes, construction notices (boilerplate traffic/road text) and backgrounders. No grading plan, tender drawing or as-built survey is published.

negativeChecks.check: City Biidaasige Park page for elevation/contour facts
negativeChecks.detail: The City park page contains no elevation, contour, promontory height or grading text.

georeferenceFeasibility.existingRasters: The GTA 2023 DTM/DSM are fully georeferenced (EPSG:3857 served, CGVD2013 vertical) and could be sampled, but they are pre-park and do not contain the final promontory/banks.
georeferenceFeasibility.promontory: No georeferenced surface of the built promontory exists in any published source. The 9 m figure is a design intent; the March 2025 transcript confirms a retaining-wall promontory with 'ground of varying elevations' but gives no numbers or coordinates.
georeferenceFeasibility.conclusion: A faithful walkable mesh of the actual current relief cannot be derived from published actual data at this time. Any promontory mesh would be an explicit estimate for captain review, not a surveyed surface.

recommendation.forCaptain: Do not build a conical hill from the single 9 m design figure. If relief is required now, treat the promontory as an explicit, labelled estimate (design intent + construction description) with a clear uncertainty note, and keep the flat native base elsewhere. The honest current-grade surface is unavailable from published sources.
nextUsefulEvidence: Request the as-built survey / grading drawings from Waterfront Toronto or the landscape contractor (not published online).
Check for a 2025/2026 City or TRCA LiDAR acquisition flight over the Port Lands (none published as of 2026-11-10).
If a future City/Provincial LiDAR refresh (2025+) is published, re-run the DTM/DSM identify at the park tiles and compare to the GTA 2023 baseline recorded here.

provenance.method: Bounded primary-source search (<=15 min). CKAN package_search, ArcGIS REST service enumeration, Ontario DTM/DSM ImageServer identify at park coordinates, Waterfront Toronto sitemap + page fetch, MVVA page fetch. No image pixels interpreted. No shared runtime touched.
